title: CTF 2v2 stall at the flag stands: ExtractHome, the real capture rule (CapAnyway), LoneGround, StageComing (2026-11-14)

facts.title: 2v2 CTF stall: the flag run's extract kept the ride at the stand; the carrier clawed on and was let go every 2 s, 22 m short
facts.fact: On 1.0.9 (rc33) a 2v2 CTF match where both VTOL+BattleArmor pairs took the other flag froze at the stands (Bogged Down c34bd0: all 4 bots still 49.7-131.4 s; VTOLs 'lift-pickup', BattleArmor 'ride-on obj=atk/hold'). order_ride lets a carrier go within 40 m of its own stand (rc33 ma2_bot_brain.c:5804), but the run's FR_EXTRACT stayed on (frun_step ends it only on 'not carrying', VTOL damage or 100 s,3478-3487) and frun_eval kept the BattleArmor's ride (G_RIDE 3.0 whenever its VTOL is within 120 m,3717) and the VTOL's fetch (G_LIFT 3.0,3703). The BattleArmor clawed onto the VTOL hovering 8.5 m over it (ctrl_do_hack, ReClaw 2 s), was let go at once 22 m from its stand, and repeated that ([BOT-CLAMP]/[BOT-LIFT] every 2 s) until the 100 s limit at 129.7/130.5. It never walked the last 12 m that score.
facts.how_to_use: ExtractHome (RECOMP_BOT_EXTRACT_HOME / [Bots] ExtractHome, default on): in FR_EXTRACT a carrier off its VTOL within 40 m of our stand takes no ride and its VTOL no fetch; the carrier walks onto the stand ([C7] extracthome: ride_dropped_s). Branch v34-ctf (NATIVE\the game source tree), exe Test 2026-10-31 \MechAssault 2 v13-v34ctf.exe. Proof on the recorded frames: fires at t=49.77 (nation 1, 22.3 m) and 50.61 (nation 2, 22.8 m) on

facts.title: MechAssault 2 scores a CTF capture with the carrier's own flag away (measured); the bots assumed the classic rule
facts.fact: Measured over 6 recordings (rc33 and v34, Bogged Down and Deliverance 2v2): all 11 flag changes 'carried -> home' came with the carrier alive 9.4-10.9 m from its OWN stand, and the game credited a capture (that player's stat 18 +1, every teammate's stat 25 +10) also when the carrier's own flag was carried by the enemy (c34bd_b1 t=57.5 port 4, c34bd_a1 t=54.6 port 4, c34de1 t=143.8 port 7). The bot code assumed a capture needs our flag on its stand: obj_ctf held a carrier 10-20 m off its stand (guard patrol) while ours was away, and RunNeedsHome blocked flag runs while our flag was carried; captures then happened only when the patrol strayed within 10 m. The 'flags time out home' seen in the stall report were these captures. CapAnyway (default on): a carrier walks onto its stand whatever the state of its own flag (a dropped own flag within 120 m is touched home first), and RunNeedsHome applies only with CapAnyway off.
facts.how_to_use: RECOMP_BOT_CTF_CAP_ANYWAY / [Bots] CapAnyway; [C7] capanyway: carrier_s. scripts\flagret.py (proof folder) lists every carried -> home with the carrier's distance to its stand; [OBJ-SCORE] lines (RECOMP_BOT_DIAG) carry the stats. The game code of sub_150880 is not in the tracked gen units, so the rule is measured, not read.

facts.title: LoneGround: a CTF bot with nobody to fly took the VTOL and flew lone cover; 1v1 had 0 flag grabs in 240 s
facts.fact: With one bot a side (1v1 + an idle player, rc33 c34bd1v Bogged Down) each bot took its team's VTOL (CtfVtolPick's pull 1.1-2.2 plus the 'no gunship up' +0.4) and flew solo cover over the enemy flag for a ground grab nobody could make: 0 grabs in 240 s. LoneGround (default on): with no other bot on the team and no teammate player in a BattleArmor, both VTOL bonuses are off (the bot takes a ground ride and grabs itself), and cover starts only with a ground teammate (a bot not in a VTOL, or a player in a ground vehicle).
facts.how_to_use: RECOMP_BOT_LONE_GROUND / [Bots] LoneGround; [C7] loneground: vtol_pick_skipped, cover_skipped. Branch v34-ctf.

facts.title: StageComing: the CTF stage hold waited 12 s for teammates who were not coming
facts.fact: the stage point waited for any live teammate (Veteran 12 s, Elite 15 s): the idle player at the spawn, a pilot respawning 700 m back and our own gunship fighting 250 m off all counted, so a 2v2 attacker stood the full wait twice in one match (c34bd_a1 bot 1, t=122-134 and 210-222). StageComing (default on): only a teammate already near (70 m of the point / 50 m of me) or a ground unit within 300 m that is not carrying their flag counts; nobody coming -> go now, latched 45 s like the staged go.
facts.how_to_use: RECOMP_BOT_STAGE_COMING / [Bots] StageComing; [C7] ctf: stage_nobody. Branch v34-ctf.

facts.title: Open: the bots' objective view lost both CTF flags mid-match (6v6 Bogged Down, after a 'carried -> carried carrier=0' event)
facts.fact: In c34bd_6v (v34 interim build, 6v6 CTF Bogged Down) both flags were dropped and picked up again at 96.9-99.1 s; at 105.2 [OBJ-EVT] printed 'carried -> carried carrier=00000000' and from then on Ma2World.nobjectives stayed 0 (the stale check in objective_update clears g_obj.n and objective_refresh, retried every 1 s, never found the flags again): no CTF play for the last 135 s, 0 captures. Not caused by the v34 changes (they do not touch the reader); whether rc33 does the same is not tested.
facts.how_to_use: Recording (+ .stderr.txt.gz). Next: dump MEM32(e+0x28) of the stale flag entity and what objective_refresh's flag-vector scan (0x50E5F4.0x50E5F8) returns at t=105.
